third_party_evaluations.summary: BSI 5-day BCMS Lead Auditor course, CQI/IRCA certified.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Recorded CQI/IRCA recognition, continuity-audit demand and a three-year profile support professional audit work; the course-and-exam description alone does not establish senior cross-domain authority.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded personnel-scheme accreditation, CQI/IRCA registration and a three-year profile support professional continuity-audit knowledge. The evidence describes a five-day BCMS course and proctored exam, so it does not by itself demonstrate extensive audit leadership.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded CQI/IRCA lead-auditor scope, personnel-scheme accreditation and three-year profile support professional continuity-audit work. The evidence describes a course and proctored exam, not expert technical security execution.
